100plus@20120922085656.title: 100Plus « Founders Fund
100plus@20120922085656.text: 100Plus is building a unique consumer experience based on health and healthy behaviors. The company wants to elevate people’s knowledge of their bodies and understanding of how daily choices impact their health. 100Plus aims to create a fun and engaging experience that will change habits and make people healthier. The company analyzes large amounts of health data (mainly from large government health data-sets and Practice Fusion’s 30+ million de-identified clinical data-set) to show users how they compare to peers, to build personalized predictions of a user’s future health, and to show the long term impact of changes in daily behavior. 100Plus believes in the power of data, technology, and design to change lives, and change the world. Founders Chris Hogg Ryan Howard Profiles CrunchBase Profile View Website

140-proof@20111026001741.name: 140 Proof
140-proof@20111026001741.title: 140 Proof « Founders Fund
140-proof@20111026001741.text: Bubble Fusion Labs creates social media applications, including 140 Proof™, the revolutionary advertising platform for Twitter that uses publicly available data from the microblogging site to channel ads to the most receptive audiences. Consumers can then retweet ads to their followers, greatly compounding advertiser exposure. The service offers users an effective, quantifiable platform for reaching targeted audiences at extraordinarily efficient prices, because advertisers pay only for first-order ads and receive free exposure in all subsequent retweets. Before launching 140 Proof, Bubble Fusion Labs developed the +1 Platform, a realtime tweet processing architecture, which powers +1 Contests, an application that allows users to recognize and record constructive achievements via Twitter. Founders Jon Elvekrog, CEO John Manoogian III, CTO Profiles Company Blog Crunchbase Profile View Website

140-proof@20140420121809.name: 140 Proof
140-proof@20140420121809.title: 140 Proof « Founders Fund
140-proof@20140420121809.text: 140 Proof is the leading social stream media platform, providing brand advertisers a simple and effective way to reach millions of consumers primed to discover and share. The company delivers share-able ads to users above their information feeds from Twitter, Facebook and other socially connected services. 140 Proof’s stream-analysis technologies match ads to the target audience persona groups based on public social cues like who they follow and keywords in their feeds. Social and viral effects deliver unique benefits to brand advertisers, while maximizing revenue for partners, enabling them to provide compelling stream-based applications and services to consumers on their web and mobile devices. The stream is everywhere — 140 Proof is headquartered in San Francisco and has sales offices in New York, Los Angeles, Chicago, Boston and Detroit. For more information visit: www.140proof.com or follow @140ProofAds on Twitter. alamofire-gowalla@20110809184036.text: The company develops software that enriches on-line social interactions. altschool@20140703011018.text: AltSchool is an innovative network of private micro-schools that combines standout teachers, parental guidance, technology, and deep research to prepare K-8 students for the world of 2030 through highly personalized learning experiences. Headquartered in San Francisco, AltSchool was founded in 2013 by technology entrepreneur and parent Max Ventilla. Following its most recent funding round, AltSchool initiated the process of becoming a certified B Corp., supporting the company’s mission to create material positive impact on society. The AltSchool team believes every child should have access to an outstanding, personalized education that enables them to be happy and successful in a world of accelerating change. amicus@20130619194746.title: Amicus « Founders Fund
amicus@20130619194746.text: Amicus (“friend” in Latin) empowers cause-driven organizations to leverage the social networks of their supporters to raise more money, attract more members, and win more votes. Amicus offers robust social intelligence by combining social graph data from Facebook and other sources with traditional offline datasets, giving organizations a holistic understanding of the people they’re trying to reach. Amicus then provides easy to use social fundraising and outreach tools that allow non-profits, political campaigns, and educational institutions to reach the people who are most likely to support their cause in the most effective way possible — through their friends. Amicus’ mission is to empower people to organize around the causes they care about through technology. Founders Seth Bannon View Website

asana@20120922085611.name: Asana
asana@20120922085611.title: Asana « Founders Fund
asana@20120922085611.text: Asana is an effort to re-imagine how teams get things done. The company is building the modern way to work together: a fast and versatile web application that connects everyone on a team with what’s going on, their shared priorities, and who owns each part of the effort. We all do great things together by aligning our energy towards a common goal, breaking the effort into parts, then marching towards the goal together. But too often, “work about work” gets in the way, and lowers our collective productivity. Our mission at Asana is to make coordination effortless, and increase the potential output of any human effort. Founders Dustin Moskovitz Justin Rosenstein Profiles CrunchBase Profile View Website

atavist@20120922085249.name: Atavist
atavist@20120922085249.title: Atavist « Founders Fund
atavist@20120922085249.text: Atavist is a media and software company at the forefront of digital, mobile publishing. The company’s mission is to enable the next generation of multimedia storytelling, reaching readers across mobile devices and the web. Atavist’s unique “create once, publish everywhere” platform allows publishers and authors to make rich, layered, multimedia stories—and publish them in a mobile app, on the web, as an ebook, or as a magazine. The company built this flexible cloud-based platform to power The Atavist, their award-winning publishing venture. Atavist’s software is now used by clients including TED Conferences, Pearson, and The Paris Review for their digital publishing needs. This year, Atavist will be opening up the platform to everyone — allowing authors, creators, and storytellers to publish anything, everywhere. More info: www.atavist.com . Founders Evan Ratliff Nicholas Thompson Jefferson Rabb View Website

backlight@20130512142756.name: Backlight
backlight@20130512142756.title: Backlight « Founders Fund
backlight@20130512142756.text: What inspires you? Behind everything we do, everything we create, and everything we love, there is a story that adds a layer of inspiration, a context, a reason… a Backlight. Backlight.org is an eye-popping oasis for the creative, meaningful part of your life. Backlight.org was founded by Brad Wolfe and Jonathan Lipps, two song-writers/humanists from Stanford who had grown tired of shallow Tweets and quick status updates and believed there could be an online community founded on something of more beauty, substance, and heart. Search Backlight’s list of “inspirations” to find thousands of stories, videos, artwork, songs, doodles, poems, photos — and their often incredible backstories. Backlight.org has worked with organizations like Stanford University, Santa Clara University, and the d.school and continues to spread creative inspiration worldwide. Founders Jonathan Lipps Profiles CrunchBase Profile View Website

business-connect-china@20121031104008.title: BCC « Founders Fund
business-connect-china@20121031104008.text: Business Connect China (BCC) is the premier provider of expert consultation, market intelligence and advisory services for the China market. The company help investment funds, professional service firms, corporations, academic and nonprofit institutions make fact-based decisions on investment and business strategies in China. BCC Network comprises of industry- and discipline-focused networks of managers, scientists, engineers, entrepreneurs, academics, and other on-the-ground professionals from around China. BCC utilizes sophisticated taxonomies and profiling tools to categorize the experience and expertise of each expert. Network experts, based on this categorization, are organized into dynamic populations to improve the accuracy and shorten the time required to generate high-quality relevant matches for client projects. Through its partnership with Advantus Global Inc. (AGI), BCC also provides comprehensive global expert networks to our clients. View Website
